name: G. Scott Fiddler
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Houston, Texas
about: G. Scott Fiddler is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2007 - 2026. He works at Jackson Walker L.L.P., located in Houston, Texas, and provides legal services for issues involving Employment & Labor: Employer, Employment Litigation: Defense and Business Litigation to the surrounding community.
Scott Fiddler completed legal studies at University of Houston Law Center and graduated with the class of 1989. Scott Fiddler passed the bar in 1990.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
